name: FSL Top-up & Eddy
summary: Corrects susceptibility distortion, eddy currents and motion in a DWI acquired with two opposite phase-encoding directions using FSL topup and eddy_openmp.
description: Merges the b0 volumes of both phase-encoding series, estimates the susceptibility field with FSL topup (b02b0.cnf), then runs eddy_openmp with --repol on the concatenated series and rotates the bvecs; a brain mask of the corrected DWI is made with bet. Use it when you have a reverse phase-encoded DWI; if not, use an eddy-only App. Note: the shell test that selects the encoding direction is always true in this branch, so acq_params.txt is always written for PA/AP regardless of the encode setting.

inputs.description: DWI acquired in the primary phase-encoding direction, with bvecs and bvals.
DWI acquired with the reversed phase-encoding direction, with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Must have the same image dimensions as diff.

outputs.description: Corrected DWI concatenating both phase-encoding series, with eddy-rotated bvecs and merged bvals.
Brain mask of the corrected DWI (FSL bet).

parameters.description: This is the 'dwell time'. Please see https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/eddy/Faq#How_do_I_know_what_to_put_into_my_--acqp_file for more information about this specific parameter.

Phase encoding direction of the diff (not rdiff), i.e. first, inputted dwi.

for example, if the phase encoding direction of the first inputted dwi is 'PA', then select 'PA'. If it was 'AP', then select 'AP'
